notes: Facts verified against shuttlestorm-site/public: SAT · NOV 21, UFV NORTH GYM, ABBOTSFORD BC (index.html hero/meta); 11 CATEGORIES / JUNIORS TO MASTERS. (index.html #manifesto, categories.html); $30–40 and PER PLAYER, PER CATEGORY (index.html .num); ENTRIES CLOSE NOV 18 (register.html); end-card line matches the site film's #rl-date; SHUTTLESTORM.ADAWAR.ORG is the canonical domain. FEATHER SHUTTLES. GREAT PRIZES. are organiser claims shown without invented specifics. No invented numbers, prizes or UI found.

Identity is clean: the end-card mark (f366–449) is the unaltered favicon.svg (byte-identical to public/research/shuttle-storm-mark.svg), not recoloured or redrawn. Surfaces are real 430px captures; the hero spotlight art is the site's own. No neon, glow, glass or gradient added; volt is flat. Marker overlays are precisely aligned to the measured DOM boxes (underlines on 'Saturday, November 21' / ages at f60, all 11 table rows at f156, '16 feathers' at f240, both 'Entries close…' lines at f330).

Causality is inverted (motion_causality 6): at every stop the display headline lands first and the on-page mark arrives afterwards, so the page action only decorates a fact that is already stated. Hero: headline f12–30, underlines f42–60. Categories: headline f108–126, row marks f126–156. Facts: headline f198–216, underline f222. Register: headline f288–306, underline f312–318. Fix: draw the mark on the page first, then have the marked phrase produce the headline (e.g. the headline line wipes out from the marker's position, or the camera pulls from the marked line to the type) so action → consequence reads.

Reference mechanism is only partly inherited (reference_fidelity 6): in kickbacks-same-run-editor the working surface is the world at task scale and the camera moves to the exact line being changed. Here each page is a ~575×860 px card (~17% of frame area) parked beside re-typed headline type, the camera is locked during every hold (f30–72, f126–168, f216–258, f306–348) and never moves to the marked line; it only pans between stops. Fix: during each mark, push in 1.6–2× onto the marked line/rows (camera tracks down the table at the categories stop as the 11 marks run), then ease back to reveal the headline.

Mobile readability at 640 px (mobile_readability 7): headlines are strong, but the focal action is not legible — the hero body copy, table rows and 'Entries close 11:59 pm' line render at ~5–7 px (small/s_010, s_025, s_055), so a phone viewer sees volt bars without reading what is marked. Mono sub-lines 'ABBOTSFORD, BC' and 'PER PLAYER, PER CATEGORY' are ~8 px at 640 px. Fix: the push-in above (marked text ≥ 28 px cap height at 1080p) and mono sub-lines ≥ 30 px.

Composition (7): four structurally identical stops (headline left, card right, hold, pan) read as a repeated template; large empty charcoal above and below the headline block on every stop (e.g. f60, f150, f240, f330). Opening f0–11 shows only the card with the left half empty before any type arrives — start the first action by f3. The register card is cropped mid-sentence ('…one partner can pay for both, or') along its bottom edge for the whole stop (f276–360); crop the capture at a clean boundary (after the Entry fees list or a full paragraph). The facts stop pairs GREAT PRIZES with a card about 565 km/h / 16 feathers / Since 1992 — acceptable, but the mark-to-headline link should be explicit for FEATHER SHUTTLES only.

No pops, overlaps or clipping errors during travel: the 24-frame pans (f72–96, f168–186, f258–276, f348–366) keep outgoing type and incoming cards separate (f78, f174, f264, f354). End card is centred, verbatim and holds static ~2.7 s after the URL settles (f384–449), which suits the website slot.

Average 7.5 with three scores below 8; reject. Highest-leverage fixes: (1) mark-then-headline order, (2) camera push to the marked line at readable scale, (3) clean register crop and immediate first action.
